summary: Backend PDF import endpoint passed deterministic checks; frontend onboarding and plan-library entry passed; PDF import review crashes after file selection due response shape mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: App crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading trim)' after selecting PDF.

integration_issues.issue: Backend returns snake_case fields (suggested_name, source_filename, row_id, total_minutes) but frontend expects camelCase (suggestedName, sourceFilename, rowId, totalMinutes). name becomes undefined and Review render crashes at name.trim().

integration_issues.flow: Save imported plan and switch active plan
integration_issues.issue: Blocked by import crash; cannot complete save/make-active/isolation verification in UI.

action_items: Normalize /api/plans/import-pdf response keys to frontend contract (camelCase) OR map response in frontend uploadPlanPdf before state usage.
Add defensive defaults before trim calls (e.g., name ?? '' and task.title ?? '').
After fix, retest full UI flow: import -> edit row -> save new plan -> library shows both plans -> make active both directions without overwriting existing plan progress.
critical_code_review_comments: Contract mismatch exists between backend Pydantic response keys (snake_case) and frontend Draft/Imported types (camelCase).
Review component assumes name is always string and calls trim() without guard.
test_credentials file is present but empty; no auth credentials available (auth flows not tested in this run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding validation passed (Continue x2 -> Build my plan), Today shows active-plan-switcher, Plan Library opens, Import route shows choose-pdf-button. Use the same sample PDF URL; backend is stable with 250 tasks and no parser issues. UI import currently crashes right after picker returns file.
rca_of_issue: Repro: open /import-plan -> tap choose-pdf-button -> attach sample PDF. Result: error boundary shows 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading trim)'. RCA: uploadPlanPdf returns backend JSON directly with snake_case keys; ImportPlanScreen expects camelCase and does setName(next.suggestedName), so name is undefined. Review render then evaluates !name.trim(), causing runtime crash and blocking save/switch/isolation checks.
test_credentials: File /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but contains no credentials; not required for this non-auth flow.
